name: route_specific_early_holdouts_decomposition

jan_apr_may_jun.week_definition: Consecutive seven-day buckets from 2025-05-01; final bucket may be shorter

mar_jun_jul_aug.week_definition: Consecutive seven-day buckets from 2025-07-01; final bucket may be shorter

decision_rationale: Jan-Apr to May-Jun loses overall from week 1 but has three local winning weeks; 14305 of 14710 excess absolute error occurs in June. Mar-Jun to Jul-Aug loses in all nine weeks. In both early holdouts routes 17, 7 and 26 add error, while all three improve on Sep-Oct; route 50 adds substantial error on Jul-Aug but improves every Sep-Oct week. Route 28 shows the opposite direction. These route-level reversals account for much of the overall architecture sign change, but this is descriptive rather than a causal mechanism.
next_minimal_experiment: Without tuning, compare signed prediction bias and weekday/weekend errors for routes 17, 7, 26 and 50 across the three saved holdout predictions.
